display_name: PAMF-REPL 全部当前论文实验与匹配对照
description: 以选定 PAMF-REPL 替换当前半监督方法，重做匹配主比较、三核心、四内部机制、相关 L 细项、两层结构及效率。189 新 F、12 精确复用；DURA 不训练，仅补已有 G 的同 F 读出。
authorization: 2026-10-24 用户要求重新完成所有 PAMF 相关实验、优化发布与加速，全部显卡可用，DURA 不重跑除非补实验。

data.label_map_ref: existing six-class / ManyRx ten-class default-head label map

roles.U_s: hidden TX labels; actual use per row

permissions.claim_scope: Three mutually exclusive populations: sourceRX D0, targetRX D1-D3, targetRX D0; D0 is earlier unseen date. Only supervised F+G-L is full L-only.

checkpoint.initialization: scratch or exact-contract E20 prefix / 12 frozen F0 models
sources: existing full G ancestors and 22 restored IQ caches
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: source.parent + prepare exact contract comparison; private checked context
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50; PAMF-REPL was previously chosen by public F0 clean scores, disclosed posthoc selection; no feedback to new runs

execution.gpu_policy: physical0-7, <=3 total/card including foreign, <=24 total; G-heavy<=1/card; free>=12000MiB, CPU<75%, RAM>=64GiB, IOwait<5%; timing naturally empty exclusive
execution.stop_rule: Two identical unresolved technical fingerprints stop new dispatch; preserve all healthy/foreign workers and immutable artifacts; no target-result stopping or selection.

expected_artifacts: 189 new F completions; 201 logical F sources
228 fully frozen predictions and independent CPU scores
CM/net correction replay and paired three-seed statistics
IEEE experiment text and vector figures

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_repl_completion.evaluation.score; separate CPU after all row decisions freeze
